summary: Valion Bio, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting entry into a letter agreement with 3i, LP to issue 1,500 Series B Preferred Shares at $1,000 per share and related warrants for $1,500,000, under an existing Series B Preferred Purchase Agreement. The securities were sold under Section 4(a)(2)/Rule 506(b) exemptions. Additionally, the company agreed to a royalty agreement granting 3i and other Series C purchasers 5% of gross revenue from subsidiary Velocity Bioworks, Inc. for ten years. No definitive agreements for additional tranches are in place. This is a routine capital-raising transaction with ordinary terms, not a special situation.
